summary_en: ktk INC. set a cost of capital target of 8–9% based on CAPM and 9–12% based on earnings yield, aiming to exceed current ROE of 7–10% through Growth Plan 2027, while working to improve PBR from 0.85x toward 1.0x or higher.
title_en: Initiatives to Realize Management Focused on Cost of Capital and Stock Price
translation_en_brief:
ktk INC. announced its Cost of Capital management target as part of Growth Plan 2027, which runs through August 2027. The company calculated its cost of equity capital at 8–9% using CAPM methodology and 9–12% using earnings yield (inverse of price-to-earnings ratio), representing management's view of investor hurdle rates.

The company's historical ROE has ranged 7–10% since August 2020, below the targeted cost of capital. The disclosure indicates this gap as a key performance challenge. Management notes that current ROE includes elevated contributions from policy shareholding disposals in August 2026, suggesting normalized underlying returns may be slightly lower.

Price-to-book ratio remains a structural concern. PBR declined to approximately 0.56x by August 2022 despite steady growth in book value per share, then recovered to 0.80x by August 2023 following IR activities and shareholder return initiatives. However, PBR stood at only 0.85x as of August 2026, indicating the market continues to discount the company's equity value relative to accounting book value. Growth Plan 2027 aims to narrow this gap by improving profitability and demonstrating consistent returns above cost of capital.
